about_the_game:
[Game Description]

A chilling truth lurks behind a fateful meeting.
The tragic ending—or your survival—depends entirely on your choices.

  • An isolated mansion, steeped in eerie black-and-white gloom. Unexpected encounters await you inside.

  • Every decision you make twists the story's path and alters the fate of its characters.

  • Death—or the act of killing—lies ahead, with multiple unpredictable endings waiting to unfold.

[Story]

Celebrated as a model citizen, you've always gone out of your way to help others.
One stormy night, as fate would have it, a stranger offers you help when you need it most.

You soon find yourself drawn into a remote mansion, gathered with other unexpected guests.
For a moment, it almost seems... peaceful.

Until the next morning, when a lifeless body is discovered.
Who did this—and why?

Can you uncover the hidden truth and survive this nightmare?

Beware: trust is a luxury you can't afford here.
Fear may be much closer than you think.

[Characters]

You

"So... this is how it ends."

A model citizen known for generous donations and tireless volunteer work.
Lost in a torrential storm after a day's labor, you manage to hitch a ride—only to end up at a secluded mansion by sheer chance.

Carly

"It's been so long since I've shared a meal with someone..."

The sorrowful owner of the mansion, a mystery novelist mourning the death of her husband a year ago.
Beneath her fragile beauty lies a well of grief, wrapped in an aura that stirs your instinct to protect her.

Solon

"Everyone gathered here has their own story.
Whether this night ends with a simple dinner... I honestly couldn't say."

A devout doctor you meet by coincidence, returning home from a late-night emergency call.
Stern and serious, he often speaks as though guided by divine providence.

Belladonna

"I'll tear you apart, piece by piece! Don't you forget it!"

A hot-tempered secretary stranded by the storm while running an errand for her boss.
Dressed in striking fashion and seething with hostility, she leaves a trail of tension wherever she goes.

Rivers

"I have a feeling tonight's going to be very entertaining!
Let's hope it stays... peaceful."

A skilled accountant who evaded a shadowy pursuer during a business trip—only to get lost in the storm.
Even in dire circumstances, his composed demeanor and enigmatic smiles hint at hidden depths—and hidden dangers.

short_description: A chance encounter. An inevitable murder. The truth always hides where you least expect it. Survive the night in this mansion.
